dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Steelers (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Broncos
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Pittsburgh opened G Gennings Dunker's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for LB Nick Herbig (hip / ribs). LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf) did not practice Wednesday, while G Gennings Dunker (knee) and WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot (plantar fasciitis)) practiced in full [RotoWire NFL Beat](https://www.rotowire.com/football/player/aaron-rodgers-4307).

Week 12 Broncos Outlook: Mike McCarthy and DC Patrick Graham open installation for the Denver Broncos (8-2, DEN -3.5, HC Sean Payton, OC Davis Webb & DC Vance Joseph (Acrisure Stadium)) as Pittsburgh prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Gerry Dulac](https://x.com/gerrydulac/status/2125611956140945760).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (2nd in AFC North • #7 Seed in AFC), Pittsburgh carries a 67% postseason projection, 11.2% AFC North division title mark, and 0.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Brooke Pryor](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49907062/aaron-rodgers-2026-nfl-season-steelers-packers-jets-tracking-records-milestones).

Around the Beat: Aaron Rodgers: Set to be waived: The Steelers plan to waive Rodgers once his contract situation is finalized, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz [RotoWire NFL Beat](https://www.rotowire.com/football/player/aaron-rodgers-4307).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Pittsburgh ranks #22 in Points / Game (21.4), #7 in Points Allowed / Game (20.1), #6 in Turnover Differential (+6), giving Mike McCarthy and Patrick Graham a clear benchmark ahead of Fri, Nov 27, 3:00 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Denver Broncos [Jordan Schultz](https://x.com/Schultz_Report/status/2125591675552841813).
